description: This PHP class defines the entity 'JobSpecificationAttachment' for use with Doctrine ORM. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_job_specification_attachment' and represents a file attachment associated with a job specification, including properties like filename, filetype, size, content, and related job title.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a job specification attachment linked to a job title.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file, as a string or resource.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle entity with this attachment.
